## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. This is audit backlog UX-22 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: A Clinic today page for the owner (in place of, or beside, Clinic overview) · owner, practice admin · phone to desktop, read only.
Findings and reviewers: F-29 · reviewer A-19 · arbitration ruling 7. Part 2 of 2 of audit backlog UX-22 (part 1 fixed the check-in timer).
Rationale: The owner, who is the buyer, has four 14-day numbers inside Settings and nothing on how the day is going. The concept showed more than the system can stand behind: seen and median consult depend on a Done state the desk could press without a doctor.
Proposed UX behaviour: One page with exactly these counts: booked today and still to arrive; arrived, split walk-in and booked; waiting now and the longest wait; notes to sign and prescriptions to authorise per doctor; registrations incomplete. Below them a needs-attention list, each line with one action (for example 3 notes unsigned from yesterday · Open). Revenue reads Not tracked yet. No seen count, median consult time, running-late figure or no-show rate until the visit states are reliable. Missing data says No data yet, never zero. The page holds counts and staff names only, no patient names.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, owner view (audit notes 11 and 12); screenshots docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/owner-1440.png, owner-1024.png, owner-768.png, owner-375.png, owner-1440-annotated.png. The concept shows more than is built: see the guide's list of what it does not settle.
Components and tokens affected: PageHeader, Card, PageMessage, Chip. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end for live counts; back end for the pending lists per doctor (authorised for owner and practice admin, tenant-scoped).
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the check-in timer ticket and the End-with-unfinished-prescription ticket (it provides prescriptions to authorise). Timing: after the safety tickets; before the pilot review meeting if time allows (ruling 7), otherwise after the first pilot weeks.
Clinical sign-off: Decision: question 17 of the validation plan (which five numbers the owner wants every evening), recorded on the issue. The five above are the default.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Revenue, no-shows, consult times and reports (MDV-P4-030). (2) Any figure derived from the unreliable Done state. (3) A wall of KPI cards.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the page, when it is read, then it shows the five counts above and no seen, median consult, running late or revenue figure
- [ ] **AC2.** Given revenue, when the page renders, then it reads Not tracked yet; given a count with no data, then it reads No data yet and not 0
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a needs-attention line, when its action is pressed, then the matching screen opens filtered to that item
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the board and the doctors' days, when the counts are compared at the same moment, then they are equal
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a receptionist or another clinic's owner, when the page's API is called, then the server answers 403 or returns only their own clinic, and the test fails if the policy is removed
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the page and its API answers, when they are read, then they hold counts and staff names only
- [ ] **AC7.** Given 375, 768 and 1440 in English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation
